title: A polyhedral framework for hierarchical Archimedean copulas: estimation, hierarchy recovery and singular asymptotics
summary: Hierarchical Archimedean copulas (HACs) admit redundant tree representations: when adjacent internal nodes have equal parameters, contracting the connecting edge leaves the copula unchanged. This creates a structural overparametrization. For homogeneous one-parameter families, we remove this redundancy and identify the resulting reduced model class with the ultrametric fan. We treat the Clayton, Frank, Ali-Mikhail-Haq, Gumbel and Joe families.
